title: Pac-Man's ghosts aren't random. Each has a rule
description: Each Pac-Man ghost picks its target differently, and one rule even includes a famous bug.

scenes.sub: each one has its own rule
scenes.say: Pac-Man's ghosts look chaotic, but they aren't. Each one follows a different rule, and that's why you can't shake them.

scenes.caption: Four ghosts, four brains
scenes.say: Blinky targets your tile. Pinky aims four tiles ahead of you. Inky uses Blinky's position to build a pincer. Clyde chases you from far away, but retreats when he gets close.
There's also a bug. When Pac-Man faces up, an overflow in the offset code shifts Pinky's target four tiles left, and Inky's two.
Blinky is the relentless one, and Clyde is the unpredictable one. Together, four simple rules create a surprisingly smart chase.
Eight tiles is Clyde's magic number, and it's why he seems to lose his nerve. Follow for more arcade secrets, one a day.
